title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Location: Office-based, PE9
Contract: Fixed Term until 30 April 2027 (6 months)
Start Date: ASAP
Hours: Negotiable, minimum 25 hours per week across at least 4 days (Monday to Friday). Maximum 35 hours per week across 5 days.

About the Role

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Office Administrator with a bookkeeping background to join a busy and friendly organisation on a fixed-term basis. This varied role will support multiple business areas, including administration, hospitality, retail, and operational functions, while providing excellent service to members, visitors, and colleagues.

The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting the organisation's migration to Xero and will contribute to the smooth day-to-day running of the office.

There is potential for this position to become permanent for the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide bookkeeping support, maintaining accurate financial records using Xero.
- Assist with the implementation and migration to Xero accounting software.
- Carry out daily cash reconciliations for retail and hospitality takings, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
- Upload invoices to the approval portal and monitor the approval process.
- Identify and recommend process improvements to increase efficiency across the organisation.
- Provide administrative support to managers and key stakeholders.
- Handle general enquiries from members and visitors in a professional and friendly manner.
- Manage bookings and reservations as required.
- Support various departments with administrative tasks.
- Provide temporary cover within the retail environment when required (subject to training).

Skills & Experience Required
- Previous experience in an office administration role.
- Bookkeeping experience with a strong working knowledge of Xero.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Word and Excel.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and work independently.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and process improvement.
- Professional and customer-focused attitude.

Benefits
- Fixed-term contract until 30 April 2027.
- Potential opportunity for the role to become permanent.
- Bank Holidays plus 20 days annual leave (pro rata).
- Flexible working hours within agreed requirements.
- Varied and interesting role within a supportive team environment.

title: Accounts Payable
company: Austin Matley HR & Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Location: East Midlands (office-based, full-time)

About the Company

Our client is seeking an organised and detail-focused Accounts Payable Clerk to join its finance team within an established business.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Clerk to manage supplier invoices, payments and purchase ledger records. The role will involve invoice processing and coding, supplier reconciliations, payment runs, bank reconciliations and supporting month-end activities. You'll also be responsible for processing overseas supplier payments, assisting with accruals and managing employee expenses and company credit cards. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with strong attention to detail who can work accurately, manage deadlines and maintain reliable financial records.

What We're Looking For
- Proven experience in accounts payable or purchase ledger.
- Experience completing bank and balance sheet reconciliations.
- Understanding of month-end processes, including accruals.
- Experience processing supplier payments, ideally including foreign currencies.
- Good working knowledge of accounting systems and confident Excel skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- AAT qualification or working towards one would be advantageous.

title: Finance Administrator
description:
Finance Administrator

Grantham, Part Time (16-30 hours), Permanent

£26,000 - £29,000 per annum FTE (pro-rata, dependent on experience)

Future Prospects Group are delighted to be working with our client, an internationally renowned company based in Grantham, who are seeking an organised and dependable Finance Administrator to join their established team on a permanent, part-time basis.

This is an great opportunity to support with the day-to-day transactional finance operations within a supportive and reputable organisation. Offering rare flexibility around your working hours, including the option of a nine-day fortnight, this role is tailored for an experienced finance or accounts professional looking for meaningful work alongside an enviable work-life balance.

THE ROLE

Your responsibilities as a Finance Administrator will include:
- Maintaining company cashbooks and completing comprehensive monthly bank reconciliations.
- Posting incoming customer receipts and outgoing supplier payments accurately and in a timely manner.
- Processing and posting up to 400 purchase invoices each month, identifying and resolving any associated invoice queries.
- Carrying out regular purchase ledger and sales ledger reconciliations alongside ad-hoc credit control tasks.
- Preparing and executing the weekly supplier payment run in accordance with company schedules.
- Processing and reconciling monthly corporate credit card statements.
- Accurately posting HMRC deferred duty and VAT entries.
- Logging project labour hours on a monthly basis to support operational project tracking.
- Supporting the Finance Manager with monthly closing, year-end accounts, and annual audit preparation.

THE CANDIDATE

The ideal Finance Administrator will be able to demonstrate the following key skills and experience:
- Previous demonstrable experience working within an accounts office or finance administration capacity.
- Strong numerical capabilities paired with high attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confidence using computer systems and Microsoft Office packages, particularly Microsoft Excel.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills when liaising with colleagues, suppliers, and clients.
- A proactive mindset with a genuine enthusiasm for learning new processes and financial systems.
- The ability to work effectively under pressure and manage tasks towards tight deadlines.
- Proven capability in establishing and nurturing positive working relationships across all levels of the business.

THE BENEFITS

The benefits included with this Finance Administrator role are:
- Exceptional working flexibility offering between 16 and 30 hours per week to suit your lifestyle.
- Access to a nine-day fortnight scheme, providing every other Friday off.
- Generous annual leave entitlement of 32 days including Bank Holidays.
- Enhanced pension scheme contributions and enhanced sick pay following probation.
- Enhanced maternity and paternity pay alongside a four-times salary death in service benefit.
- Free on-site car parking, complimentary tea and coffee, eye test vouchers, and a cycle to work scheme.
- Regular company social events including a Christmas party and summer barbecue.

Thank you for your interest in this vacancy and good luck with your application.

If you have not heard from a member of the Future Prospects team within 7 days from your application, please assume that your application has not been successful on this occasion. Unfortunately, due to the high volume of applications we receive, we are unable to provide individual feedback.

The services of Future Prospects are those of an Employment Agency.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant
Grantham £26,000 to £28,000
Do you enjoy a varied accounts role where you can get involved across the finance function?

An established manufacturing business in Grantham is looking for a Finance Assistant to join its Accounts and Payroll team. Supporting the Finance Manager and Finance Director, you will help keep everyday finances running smoothly, with responsibilities spanning purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control and weekly payroll.

The role
- Processing purchase invoices, reconciling supplier statements and resolving queries.
- Maintaining the sales ledger and chasing outstanding customer payments.
- Maintaining the cash book and completing weekly reconciliations.
- Preparing weekly payroll using Sage and helping monitor time and attendance.
- Liaising with customers and suppliers.
- Supporting the wider finance team with accounts administration and other duties.

About you
You will have previous experience in an accounts role, good Excel skills and a careful, organised approach. You should be comfortable handling queries, working to deadlines and moving between different tasks.

Experience across both purchase ledger and sales ledger would be useful, alongside reconciliations and credit control. Payroll experience, particularly using Sage, would also be an advantage.

You do not need a particular accounting qualification. Practical experience, accuracy and a willingness to contribute to the team are what matter.

This role would suit an Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or Bookkeeper who enjoys variety and wants to put their everyday accounting skills to use within an established business.

Apply today or contact BTG Recruitment for a confidential conversation.
